card.name: Spaces before numbers in Lenvima label
card.fires_on: The space or small piece just before a number in the lenvatinib (LENVIMA) label, such as a section number, grade number or study number. It also fires inside the brand name LENVIMA.

modes.label: Before section numbers

modes.label: Before grade or study numbers
modes.description: The space after Grade or Study, just before the number.
